source_scope: Connected finite simple graphs on 3 through 6 vertices in NetworkX graph_atlas_g
proof_of_certificate: Each target equals 1*t^T+t*1^T for distinct nonnegative integer t, hence has exactly one positive eigenvalue. Exact derivative Hessians have negative determinant and positive trace, hence two positive eigenvalues. This violates the necessary Lorentzian Hessian condition.
limits: Bounded census only; the conjecture for arbitrary order remains unproved.
